note: Attempt 1 on a real Phala TDX VM (dstack-0.6.1), 2026-11-04. NOT a successful verification. The Intel quote verified, the platform was dstack-tdx with TCB UpToDate on a production OS image, and the quote's report data equalled sha512(our keys, our fresh nonce). The run was rejected because the verifier image used (Docker Hub dstacktee/dstack-verifier:latest, built 2026-09-10) predates dstack 0.6 and could not parse the guest's vm_config.tdx_measurement, so the event log, OS image and compose hash checks failed as a cascade. Superseded by a run with the official ghcr.io/dstack-tee/dstack-verifier image.
